module.name: roksbnkctl-cluster-create
module.description: Provision a NEW IBM ROKS cluster with its own VPC and Transit Gateway, then register it with BNK Forge. The counterpart to cluster-registry, which adopts a cluster you already own.

required.name: prefix
required.label: Resource prefix
required.description: Prefix for every IBM resource this creates (VPC, cluster, Transit Gateway).

required.name: cluster_name
required.label: New cluster name
required.description: Name for the ROKS cluster to CREATE. It must not already exist.

optional.name: workers_per_zone
optional.label: Workers per zone
optional.description: Across three zones; 2 gives a 6-worker cluster.

optional.name: public_gateway
optional.label: Worker Internet egress
optional.description: false builds a DISCONNECTED cluster whose workers have no egress — images must come from a private mirror and licensing from an F5 License Proxy.

key_outputs.name: cluster_id
key_outputs.description: ID of the created ROKS cluster.

key_outputs.name: cluster_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the created ROKS cluster.

key_outputs.name: vpc_id
key_outputs.description: ID of the VPC created for the cluster.

key_outputs.name: transit_gateway_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the Transit Gateway created for the cluster. Downstream modules adopt this rather than creating their own.
